cards.body_en: Standing wreaths and mourning baskets for funerals, memorials and wake halls. Delivered on time to Kuching funeral parlours.
cards.body_zh: 庄重立式花圈与哀悼花篮，用于丧礼、追悼会、治丧处，准时送达古晋各殡仪馆。
key_points_zh: 庄重立式花圈与哀悼花篮
丧礼追悼会治丧处使用

cards.body_en: For bereaved families and friends at funerals, memorial services or wake halls in Kuching.
cards.body_zh: 适合丧家与亲友，用于丧礼、追悼会或治丧处场合。

cards.body_en: Can it arrive same day? Are flowers fresh? Delivery to which parlours?
cards.body_zh: 可以当天送到吗？花材新鲜吗？送到哪间殡仪馆？

cards.body_en: When someone shares a loss, offer condolences first, then gently ask if they need help arranging a wreath.
cards.body_zh: 听到丧事时先致意慰问，再温和地问是否需要帮忙安排花圈。

cards.body_en: Large festive baskets with money trees or lucky bamboo and congratulatory ribbons for openings.
cards.body_zh: 大型喜庆花篮，可搭配发财树或开运竹及祝贺布条。
key_points_en: Money tree or lucky bamboo options

cards.body_en: For new shops, housewarmings, ribbon-cuttings and exhibitions.
cards.body_zh: 适合开幕、乔迁、剪彩、展会等喜庆场合。

cards.body_en: Can you add a money tree? What size? Delivery on opening day?
cards.body_zh: 可以加发财树吗？多大尺寸？开幕当天送到吗？

cards.body_en: When someone mentions a new shop or move, offer a festive basket with ribbon.
cards.body_zh: 听到开幕或乔迁时，推荐大型喜庆花篮并加祝贺布条。
key_points_en: Listen for opening or moving news

cards.body_en: Refined bouquets with roses, tulips, sunflowers, carnations, hydrangeas and lisianthus.
cards.body_zh: 精致花束，包含玫瑰、郁金香、向日葵、康乃馨、绣球、洋桔梗等。

cards.body_en: Birthdays, proposals, anniversaries, graduations, Valentine’s and Mother’s Day.
cards.body_zh: 适合生日、求婚、纪念日、毕业、情人节、母亲节。

cards.body_en: Can you match this photo? Which flowers for the occasion? How fresh?
cards.body_zh: 可以照这张图做吗？什么花适合这个场合？新鲜吗？

cards.body_en: Ask the occasion and suggest suitable flowers, then request a current quote for the customer in the App.
cards.body_zh: 先问场合，推荐合适花材，再由你在App帮客人申请当下报价。
key_points_en: You request the quote in the App

cards.body_en: Bridal bouquets, boutonnieres, car flowers, sign-in areas, arches and table flowers with full design and setup.
cards.body_zh: 新娘手捧花、襟花、婚车、签到区、拱门、桌花，提供全案设计与现场布置。

cards.body_en: For couples and event organisers needing complete floral design and installation.
cards.body_zh: 适合新人与活动主办方，需要完整花艺设计与现场布置。

cards.body_en: Can you do the full setup? Do you match reference photos? Delivery and installation?
cards.body_zh: 可以全案布置吗？能照参考图做吗？会现场安装吗？

cards.body_en: When someone mentions a wedding, offer full design from bouquet to arch and setup.
cards.body_zh: 听到婚礼时，推荐从手捧花到拱门的全案设计与现场布置。

cards.body_en: Bulk fresh flowers and foliage for local florists, wedding planners and event teams, by pre-order.
cards.body_zh: 散装鲜花与叶材，供应本地花店、婚礼策划与活动团队，预订制。

cards.body_en: Local flower shops, wedding planners and event teams that need bulk supply.
cards.body_zh: 适合本地花店、婚礼策划与活动团队需要大量花材时。

cards.body_en: Do you sell bulk? Minimum order? Can I pre-order for a date?
cards.body_zh: 可以批发吗？有最低量吗？可以预订特定日期吗？

cards.body_en: If a florist or planner needs volume, explain bulk pre-order, then request a current quote in the App.
cards.body_zh: 花店或策划需要大量时，说明预订批发，再由你在App申请当下报价。
key_points_en: You request the quote in the App

scripts.text_en: So sorry for your loss. If you need a wreath for the wake, I can help arrange it and make sure it reaches the parlour on time.
scripts.text_zh: 听到这个消息很遗憾，请节哀。如果治丧处需要花圈，我可以帮你安排，并确保准时送到殡仪馆。

scripts.text_en: If the conditions are met we can try same-day delivery to the parlour. Let me check with the company for you.
scripts.text_zh: 如果符合条件，我们可以尝试当天送到殡仪馆。我帮你跟公司确认一下。

scripts.text_en: Our flowers come by air to Kuching airport with proper clearance. Pre-order and stock checks help keep them fresh.
scripts.text_zh: 我们的花材是古晋机场空运直采清关的。预订制和盘点有助于保持新鲜。

scripts.text_en: Congrats on the opening! Would you like a large festive basket with a congratulatory ribbon?
scripts.text_zh: 恭喜开幕！需要大型喜庆花篮加祝贺布条吗？

scripts.text_en: Happy housewarming! We can prepare a festive basket, and money tree or lucky bamboo can be added.
scripts.text_zh: 乔迁之喜！我们可以准备喜庆花篮，也可以搭配发财树或开运竹。

scripts.text_en: Prices follow the current quote. Tell me the date, size and budget, and I'll get the quote for you.
scripts.text_zh: 价格以当下报价为准。告诉我日期、尺寸和预算，我帮你申请报价。

scripts.text_en: Happy birthday to her! Would you like a refined bouquet with roses or sunflowers?
scripts.text_zh: 祝她生日快乐！需要精致花束吗？玫瑰或向日葵都可以。

scripts.text_en: For a proposal, a rose or tulip bouquet works well. Photos are style reference only; I’ll check seasonal flowers.
scripts.text_zh: 求婚的话，玫瑰或郁金香花束很合适。图片只是风格参考，我会确认当季花材。

scripts.text_en: Mother's Day is coming. Carnations or hydrangeas make a warm bouquet. Shall I get you a current quote?
scripts.text_zh: 母亲节快到了，康乃馨或绣球很温暖。要我帮你申请当下报价吗？

scripts.text_en: Congratulations on the wedding! We can do the full design from bridal bouquet to arch and on-site setup.
scripts.text_zh: 恭喜你们！我们可以从新娘手捧花到拱门做全案设计，并负责现场布置。

scripts.text_en: The photo is great for style reference. Flower types and colours will adjust to seasonal supply; I’ll confirm with you first.
scripts.text_zh: 这张图很好做风格参考。花材和颜色会依当季供应调整，我会先跟你确认。

scripts.text_en: Have you decided on the date? I can check availability and get a quote for you.
scripts.text_zh: 日期定了吗？我可以帮你确认档期并申请报价。

scripts.text_en: Hi, we supply bulk flowers and foliage by pre-order for local florists. What do you need?
scripts.text_zh: 你好，我们提供预订制散装鲜花与叶材给本地花店。需要什么？

scripts.text_en: For wedding or event volume, we do bulk pre-orders. Tell me the date and I'll get a current quote for you.
scripts.text_zh: 婚礼或活动大量需求可以预订批发。告诉我日期，我帮你申请当下报价。

scripts.text_en: Stock depends on pre-order and schedule. I’ll confirm with the company and get back to you.
scripts.text_zh: 库存视预订与排期而定。我帮你跟公司确认后再回复。

faqs.q_en: I saw negative reviews on Google
faqs.q_zh: 我在 Google 看到负评
faqs.a_en: We take every feedback seriously and focus on fresh flowers and on-time service. If there is a specific concern, I can help confirm with the company.
faqs.a_zh: 我们重视每份反馈，专注新鲜花材与准时服务。如有具体问题，我帮你跟公司确认。

faqs.a_en: The company handles import documents itself. Flowers arrive by air freight to Kuching airport with direct clearance. Pre-orders and inventory checks reduce waste and keep flowers fresh.
faqs.a_zh: 公司自行处理进口文件，古晋机场空运直采清关。预订制与库存盘点减少损耗，保持花材新鲜。

faqs.q_en: Can you make it exactly like this photo?
faqs.a_en: The photo is for style reference only. Flower types and colours will be adjusted according to seasonal supply. I must tell you this first.
faqs.a_zh: 图片仅供风格参考。花材与颜色会依当季供应调整，我必须先告诉你。

faqs.a_en: Condolence wreaths can be same-day if conditions are met. Other items depend on stock and schedule. Let me confirm with the company for you.
faqs.a_zh: 帛事花圈符合条件可当日送达。其他视库存与排期。我帮你跟公司确认。

faqs.a_en: Yes, Samarahan is within our delivery areas (subject to stock and schedule).
faqs.a_zh: 是的，Samarahan在配送区域内（视库存与排期）。

faqs.a_en: Prices follow the current quote, because flowers change by season. Tell me the occasion, date and budget and I'll get the quote for you.
faqs.a_zh: 花材随季节变动，价格以当下报价为准。告诉我场合、日期和预算，我帮你申请报价。

faqs.q_en: Which areas do you deliver to?
faqs.a_en: Kuching, Matang, Batu Kawa, Tabuan Jaya, Petra Jaya, Satok, Padawan, Siburan and Samarahan, subject to stock and schedule.
faqs.a_zh: Kuching、Matang、Batu Kawa、Tabuan Jaya、Petra Jaya、Satok、Padawan、Siburan、Samarahan，视库存与排期。

faqs.q_en: Do you have stock of this flower now?
faqs.a_en: Availability depends on pre-orders and current stock. I'll confirm with the company and get back to you.
faqs.a_zh: 有没有货要看预订和当下库存，我帮你跟公司确认后回复你。

faqs.q_en: Can you do wholesale for my shop?
faqs.q_zh: 可以给我的花店批发吗？
faqs.a_en: Yes, we supply bulk flowers and foliage to local florists, planners and event teams by pre-order.
faqs.a_zh: 可以，我们以预订制供应散装鲜花与叶材给本地花店、婚礼策划与活动团队。

faqs.q_en: Do you provide on-site setup for weddings?
faqs.a_en: Yes, wedding and event service includes full design and on-site installation for bouquets, arches, table flowers and more.
faqs.a_zh: 可以，婚礼与活动提供全案设计与现场布置，包括手捧花、拱门、桌花等。

faqs.q_en: How do I place an order?
faqs.a_en: Just WhatsApp me the occasion, date, delivery area and budget. I'll get the quote and arrange the order for you.
faqs.a_zh: 直接WhatsApp告诉我场合、日期、送货地区和预算，我帮你申请报价并安排下单。

faqs.q_en: Can I see real customer photos?
faqs.q_zh: 可以看真实客户照片吗？
faqs.a_en: Yes, I can share photos of arrangements we have made. They are for reference; the final piece follows seasonal flowers.
faqs.a_zh: 可以，我把我们做过的作品照给你看。作品照仅供参考，成品会依当季花材调整。
